youtube.title: The CIA Ordered These Files Destroyed. They Missed Some. | MKUltra
youtube.description:
From 1953 to 1973, the CIA ran MKUltra: mind-control experiments, often on people who never consented. In 1973, Director Richard Helms ordered the files destroyed. In 1977, about 20,000 surviving documents turned up through a records request.

📂 Case File #005: MKUltra

Sources: U.S. Senate hearing, "Project MKULTRA, the CIA's Program of Research in Behavioral Modification" (1977); Church Committee final report (1976); overview: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MKUltra
Images: declassified CIA documents and U.S. government records, public domain.
Narration voice: AI.
